description: Definitions and construction of schemes; sets and basic undergraduate algebra are assumed. Complete sections are imported; their source references are followed recursively, except the explicitly classified comparisons, additional examples, and alternative proofs below.

reference_exceptions.dpa-section-divided-power-rings: An additional example of a category; divided powers are not used in defining schemes.
reference_exceptions.sets-section-sets-everything: Set-theoretic foundations are assumed by the reader.
reference_exceptions.fields-example-quotient-field: Fields of fractions are part of assumed undergraduate algebra.
reference_exceptions.sites-definition-presheaf: A comparison with presheaves on general sites; the definition on spaces is given here.
reference_exceptions.sites-section-sheafification: An alternative, more general construction; the construction on spaces is given here.
reference_exceptions.modules-lemma-s-open: An alternative proof; the source supplies a direct proof in the included section.
reference_exceptions.algebra-example-affine-open-not-standard: A further example about affine opens; not used in the construction or definition.
reference_exceptions.properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-clos: A forward comparison with Noetherian schemes; not used in the construction or definition.
reference_exceptions.homology-definition-filtered: Background for an additional example of a nonabelian category, not used in the construction.
